risks.risk: Gearbox may slip, shift harshly or not engage gears.

risks.if_unproven: as not working, for rebuild or parts

risks.risk: Case may be cracked or the tail and pan damaged on sides not shown.

A clip of the gearbox fitted and shifting through all gears and reverse.
A written list of what is included: gearbox only, or with torque converter, module or engine.
Photos of both sides and the underside of the gearbox.
A photo of the receipt and warranty if they exist.
